h:
这是一个工作流程，演示如何将步骤计划的各个部分分散到不同的阶段，以在总体上具有相同数量的步骤/计算机的情况下增强生成。

主要是，您可以将早期步骤和后期步骤分割到不同的阶段，这样您就可以分配不同的权重、提示、分辨率、模型、步骤密度等，并完成一些巧妙的事情，通常只需很少或没有额外的开销。

它与这篇文章配对：https://civitai.com/articles/9191

o.en:
This is a workflow demonstrating how to spread sections of a step schedule across different stages to enhance generation with the same number of steps/computer overall.

Primarily, you can split earlier steps and later steps to different stages so you can assign different weight, prompt, resolution, model, step density, etc. and accomplish some neat things, often with little or no extra overhead.

It pairs with this article:https://civitai.com/articles/9191
